title: Question 20
passage:
Which receipt do I need to pick up my repaired boots?
A. We'll have them ready by four. B. The one marked with your claim number. C. You can pay for the repair when you get here.
passageZh:
我要拿哪張收據來取修好的靴子？
A. 我們最遲會在四點準備好。
B. 有註明你取件號碼的那一張。
C. 你到這裡後再付修理費即可。
